items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 3:1
items.html: All the Partzufim in the three worlds BYA of the Klipot were explained above in answer 2, see there. And in the world of Atzilut of the Klipa there are only two Partzufim: ZA and Nukva alone. For nothing at all falls to the Klipot from the GAR of Atzilut, God forbid. And the reason is that the Klipot exist only in the empty void, that is, below the conclusion of the line of the Ein Sof, blessed be He, which is beneath the Malchut that concludes all holiness. Now, in the first restriction this was beneath the feet of AK standing upon the point of this world. However, in the second restriction, when the concluding Malchut ascended to the place of the Bina of the body, which is the discernment of the Chazeh [chest] of the Partzuf TNHY of SAG of AK, and there was spread the Parsa that concludes holiness, and the two lower thirds of Tifferet and NHYM of this Partzuf went out to the discernment of the empty void (as above, Item 3), which became the place of the three worlds BYA — then the Klipot seized the entire measure of the three worlds BYA, by reason of their being the discernment of empty void.
